summary: July is peak summer in the north: beaches, festivals and the busiest, priciest weeks of the year.
intro: School holidays fill Europe's coasts and cities, and the Mediterranean is at its hottest, so book ahead and plan the middle of the day indoors. Further north, Scandinavia, Iceland and the British Isles have their warmest, longest weeks.

On the other side of the world it's the dry season on Bali and in East Africa, where the great wildebeest migration usually crosses into Kenya's Masai Mara from about July. Winter brings snow to the Andes and to New Zealand's mountains.
